kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتحذلق (form IIq)
# أَتَحَذْلَقُ (ʔataḥaḏlaqu) /ʔa.ta.ħað.la.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# أَتَحَذْلَقَ (ʔataḥaḏlaqa) /ʔa.ta.ħað.la.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# أَتَحَذْلَقْ (ʔataḥaḏlaq) /ʔa.ta.ħað.laq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
